corrections.why: The tower was moved to Platte Mountain in 1956 and the register lists it there. 'Gone' fits only the original site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Former Fire Lookout Sites register gives 1920 as the earliest date, and the NHLR says a lookout stood there by 1924. We keep 1920 as the built year and note 1924 in the events.

The Former Fire Lookout Sites entry says the cabin may have gone to Pratt Mountain. The NHLR says CDF moved the tower and house to Platte Mountain in 1956. The NHLR account is dated and specific, so we follow it.

notes_for_editor: The tower moved to Platte Mountain (NHLR US 1309, CA 132) should be linked to this record or flagged as its moved structure. The NHLR height text is garbled ('from 45 1 to 92' high'), so no height is given for the moved tower. A Forestry Diary page titled Lone Pine Lookout (coordinates 40.0234, -121.4789, about 24 km from this site) describes a different lookout; do not merge them. Platte Mountain is listed as private land under a lease; access was not checked. The 1937 and 1946 details come from clippings reprinted on californialookouts.weebly.com; originals were not checked. The register's 1920 and 1924 dates differ and are both shown.
